_meta.description: CDFI weighting matrix — metric weights keyed to doctrinal authority level
_meta.specification: SAICRED Implementation Guidelines, Section 3.5 (Mark Julius Banasihan, March 2026)
_meta.note: All columns sum to 1.00. Gate metrics (hallucination, relativism_resistance) are excluded from weighted sum and handled separately in threshold_gates.yaml.

defined_dogma._description: Formally and definitively defined by the Church — Council definitions, solemn papal ex cathedra pronouncements

ordinary_magisterium._description: Regular, ongoing authoritative teaching — encyclicals, apostolic exhortations, consistent episcopal teaching

theological_consensus._description: Positions held by substantial majority of Catholic theologians — not formally defined but reflected in authoritative catechesis
_examples: Nature of original sin and transmission
Theology of grace within Tridentine bounds

legitimate_opinion._description: Questions the Church has explicitly left open — Catholics may hold different positions in good faith

_default_note: Used when authority_level is unclassified. SAICRED v2 applied this default to all 400 prompts pending theological advisor classification. Rankings are preliminary until full classification is complete.
